name: 合同付款核查
description: 核查合同已付金额，防止超合同付款
statement: SELECT c.contract_no, c.contract_name, c.contract_amount, SUM(p.payment_amount) AS paid_total FROM 合同主表 c LEFT JOIN 付款主表 p ON c.contract_no = p.contract_no GROUP BY c.contract_no
sql: SELECT c.contract_no, c.contract_name, c.contract_amount, SUM(p.payment_amount) AS paid_total FROM 合同主表 c LEFT JOIN 付款主表 p ON c.contract_no = p.contract_no GROUP BY c.contract_no
